description: This file defines the ToDoItem class, representing an individual to-do item with properties such as title and completion status, including constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ToDoItem
classes.description: A class modeling a single to-do list item with attributes for title and completion status, including methods to access and modify these attributes.

methods.name: ToDoItem(String title)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a to-do item with a title and defaults completed status to false.

methods.name: ToDoItem(String title, boolean completed)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a to-do item with a title and specified completion status.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Returns whether the to-do item is marked as completed.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion status of the to-do item.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the to-do item.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the to-do item.
